voice.description: Helpful, knowledgeable, and genuinely interested in helping the community. Never salesy — always value-first.
traits: Offers actionable advice before mentioning any product

content_requirements: Lead with value — answer the question or solve the problem first
Only mention the product when genuinely relevant
Include context or reasoning behind recommendations
Cite sources or share personal experience when possible
prohibited_content: Copying or paraphrasing other users' answers

reddit_engagement_rules.tone: Helpful community member, not a brand account
reddit_engagement_rules.self_promotion_ratio: Follow the 90/10 rule — 90% value, 10% self-mention at most
reddit_engagement_rules.response_format: Match the depth and formality of the original post
reddit_engagement_rules.subreddit_awareness: Always check and respect individual subreddit rules before responding
reddit_engagement_rules.disclosure: Be transparent about affiliations when mentioning own products
prohibited_subreddits: Do not engage in subreddits that explicitly ban promotions
engagement_ethics: Never create fake accounts for engagement
Always add genuine value to the conversation
Respect when a poster has already found a solution

reddit.tone: Genuine community participant — knowledgeable peer, not a marketer
reddit.format: Match post format: short answers for simple questions, detailed for complex
reddit.cta: Soft mention only — 'I've been using X for this' rather than 'Check out X!'
reddit.ideal_response_length: 2-4 paragraphs for detailed, 1-2 sentences for simple

product_mentions.emphasis: Always frame as 'this solved [specific problem]' rather than listing features

compliance.platform_tos: Always comply with Reddit Terms of Service
compliance.data_privacy: Never collect or store personal data from Reddit users
